title: response
description: The state of a failsafe Task: one run of a failsafe rule's response, named by rule_id and attempt, with no task_id from Core. The Asset sends it active when the rule activates, with the response as it runs, parameters fixed; then one final state, completed, failed or cancelled. It is never queued. A cancelled response was interrupted by a higher-priority rule or replaced by an operator override. Activation has already cancelled ordinary work and raised clear_count.
